comments.body: 2026-11-13, Codex 0.167.2 (observation section 11, corpus/codex-0.167.2/model-errors.txt): with the provider's port closed Codex was still retrying at six minutes, with and without retry settings at zero, so what fires on giving up is still unknown. HTTP 400/503 end the turn with no Stop or Interrupt; Muster reads done after its 10 s quiet-report fallback.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: 2026-10-04: with the model provider at 127.0.0.1:9, Codex 0.154 fired UserPromptSubmit and then no hook for over 3 minutes while showing 'Reconnecting... waiting for network'; Muster reads it working, and no declared wait stands. What it fires once it gives up (Stop, Interrupt, nothing) needs a capture longer than 3 minutes (corpus/codex-0.154.0/api-error.txt, observation section 10).
title: Codex: what fires when it stops retrying an unreachable model
